{{Quote|Ah.... Sir, more ships dropping out of hyperspace.|Loccin to Darth Caedus|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>}}
'''Loccin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] junior officer aboard the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']], and the replacement of [[Patra Tebut]] after her [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of [[Darth Caedus]]. He feared Caedus, but informed him of the destruction of the [[Minelayer (starship type)|minelayers]] outside of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] shortly before the [[Second Battle of Fondor]]. When [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] and her [[Maw Irregular Fleet]] dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] at the end of the battle, Loccin was the one who told Caedus. Since Loccin and [[Duv-Horlo]], another junior officer, were also able to see the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], not just Caedus, he realized that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] must have been pulling off a larger [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] illusion than the one he had experienced earlier.
